title: 7/04-7/10: entry check v2 treated present_unverified as confirmed (terminal), so a wrong player or a missing DD slot hidden by a crosswalk gap would have passed silently
tier_reason: entry-verification masking (a missing DD leg could go unalerted); no firing evidenced (7/08's missed leg took the alerted path, I-072); B -> A: at HEAD a marker still present_unverified at the cutoff produces no EOD record

contract.text: check-pick-entered reports the delivered pick as entered only when every delivered slot's player is verified in the contest entry; a wrong player or a missing double-down slot alerts.
contract.source: ARCHITECTURE.md 'bts check-pick-entered' (identity-verified, both DD slots, 2026-07-04); contest_fetch.pick_entry_status docstring at df15eb0

mechanism.text: pick_entry_status returned (True, present_unverified) whenever an entered row could not be mapped through the BTS->MLB crosswalk (or the crosswalk was empty), even with fewer rows entered than slots delivered
check_pick_entered wrote status confirmed for any ok result, and a confirmed marker ends the day's checking

residual.text: A marker still present_unverified at the cutoff yields no EOD record: the pick_entry health source flags only alerted and dm_failed
residual.source: src/bts/health/pick_entry.py check() at 4490aee (unchanged at HEAD); code reading

residual.text: No postponed-game awareness in the entry checker (nags and a false EOD WARN for a selection that will Pass); deferred as a product call

watchdog.trigger: at a delivered pick's cutoff (earliest slot first pitch - 5) the day's entry marker is anything but an exact-match confirmation (present_unverified, alerted, dm_failed or absent)
watchdog.recovery_assertion: an exact-match confirmation for every delivered slot before the cutoff, or a recorded operator acknowledgement

evidence.locator: docs/audit/2026-07-09-gpt56-sol-audit.md 'Fix-batch adversarial review round' #1; commit e5ef7ca body
evidence.what: present_unverified was terminal confirmed, so a wrong player hidden by a crosswalk gap ended the day's checking; now only an exact match is terminal and a missing slot count is a mismatch

evidence.locator: src/bts/contest_fetch.py pick_entry_status at df15eb0 (identical at 115c0cf) and src/bts/cli.py check_pick_entered at 115c0cf
evidence.what: the masking needs an unresolvable entered row or an empty crosswalk; a resolvable single-leg entry already returned mismatch
the defective check was installed continuously from 7/04 04:10:53Z until 7/10 15:20:05Z
7/08's DD leg went unentered past a single 18:00 alert because alerted was terminal: the 7/08 path was 'alerted', not present_unverified

notes: the row's 'DL?' holds: code + logged installs; firing would need a DD day 7/04-7/10 with one entered leg the crosswalk could not resolve; Route R: pick_entry_check.json history and the contest ledger for those days
the first v2 install (720651a, 7/04 03:07:46Z, ~1 h overnight) counted any entered row via has_prediction_for, an even coarser version of the same masking
e5ef7ca also reworked I-073 fixes before their first install; the e5ef7ca entry-check hunks are this record's
